name: github-ticket-search
description: Search GitHub tickets using a query.
script:
set -e
repo="$PECORE_PROJECT_REPO_OWNER/$PECORE_PROJECT_REPO_NAME"
items=$(gh issue list --repo "$repo" --search "$PECORE_PARAMS_QUERY" --state all --json number,title --limit 100 | jq -e 'map({id: (.number | tostring), title})')
printf '%s\n' "$items" | jq -e '{title: "Tickets", body: tojson}'
